name: ReportIt
description: Turn chosen notes, tasks and issues into one tidy PDF report with a cover, contents and page numbers. Your notes stay as they are.
author: Notible
guide:
Open **ReportIt** in the sidebar.

1. Pick the items to include on the left; drag them into the order you want.
2. Give the report a title, and choose which properties to show (status, priority and due are on to start with). Tasks and issues can go into one table instead of a page each.
3. Click **Generate report**, check the preview, and print it to PDF.

Whiteboards come out as a readable outline of their cards and arrows.
